alyssa: kicking off a quick experiment — want to test a bid-envelope approach across search and retargeting for the next 2 weeks. high-level: cap bids at +25% for high-intent keywords, -30% for low perf keywords. parallel creative swap for retargeting. thoughts?
jamie: +1. can we schedule two flights? week1 test, week2 ramp if CPA improves. also need clean UTM so attribution is unambiguous.
omar: agreed. I'll spin up the campaign structure. what are the decision thresholds for CPA / CTR to decide ramp vs rollback?
alyssa: control CPA = $45, target improvement >=15% to ramp. min sample = 500 clicks per flight. rollback if CTR drops >10% or conversion rate drops >12%.
lex: creative status — we have 3 headlines, 2 CTAs, and 2 image variations per audience segment. naming is creative_v2_h1_ctaA etc. pushed to Drive.
alyssa: link in the doc: https://drive.company/marketing/paid/1839 — please use utm_experiment=bid-envelope-1839 on all ad URLs.
jamie: @omar please add experiment flag in GA and in our Ads manager. also separate adsets for retargeting so we can flip creative without affecting search.
omar: will do. quick rule snippet I'll add to campaign manager: 
```
if daily_spend > 2000 and CPA > 60:
  pause_campaign()
  notify(#marketing)
```
lex: good call. I'll monitor landing page engagement (bounce, session duration) and surface any drops in #marketing.
jamie: routing note — high-intent form fills should go to SDR queue immediately (tag: priority). all other leads into the existing nurture flow.
omar: setting lead tags: lead_source=search_envelope, utm_exp=bid-envelope-1839, route=SDR_priority when form_score >= 80.
mkt-bot: Campaigns created (paused): search-bid-envelope-1839, retarget-bid-envelope-1839. Use `/deploy-campaign search-bid-envelope-1839 --start` to activate.
alyssa: timeline: activate Monday 9am PT. @lex will post daily snapshot at 10am (CTR, CPA, conversion rate, spend).
jamie: for isolation we will NOT run landing page A/Bs during this run — we want to measure bid + creative only.
alyssa: agreed. one more — cost consideration: enable dynamic hourly pacing so we don't blow budget early. keep daily caps strict.
omar: dynamic pacing on, daily caps configured. will set campaign labels and notified team when live.
lex: I'll prepare a short persona heatmap to see which headlines land with which audience segment.
alyssa: awesome. everyone clear? :thumbsup:
lex: clear
omar: clear
jamie: ready
alyssa: final checklist and links will be posted Sunday evening. activating Monday morning.
